en_US.text:
[Manual rule] 3 random ordinary pieces → blast cores.
Keep colors; convert all if fewer than 3.

保留原色，不足3枚则全部转化。

Keep colors; convert all if fewer than 3.

en_US.text:
[Manual rule] 3 random ordinary pieces → column sweepers.
Keep colors; convert all if fewer than 3.

en_US.text:
Next 3 actual refills: adjust count by -1; skipped refills spend no uses.
One random color's generation weight +2 persists after expiry (not probability); locked previews stay.

接下来3次实际补棋，数量修正-1枚；免补棋不扣次数。
一种随机确定颜色的生成权重+2（非概率），减量到期后仍保留，锁定预告不重抽。

en_US.text: Clear a chosen ordinary color (fuses too; no match base points). Randomly select a surviving ordinary color and up to 3 off-color ordinary survivors to dye; skip if none. Chains follow all outermost steps.

zh_CN.text: 先自选颜色清除该色普通棋（含引信，不得匹配基础分）；再随机选存活普通棋现有颜色，随机染色至多3枚存活异色普通棋，无目标跳过。最外层效果全部完成后再连锁。

en_US.text: From the next stage target: 25 extra points per completion, unaffected by the score multiplier. No retroactive reward.

zh_CN.text: 从下一个阶段目标起，每次达标额外得25分，不受分数倍率影响，不补发当前已完成目标。

en_US.text:
[Manual rule] Unlock row sweeper supply and place one.
Clears its row when removed.

zh_CN.text:
[人工规则] 解锁行清除补给，立即放入一枚。
消除时扫清所在行。

en_US.text:
[Manual rule] Unlock column sweeper supply and place one.
Clears its column when removed.

zh_CN.text:
[人工规则] 解锁列清除补给，立即放入一枚。
消除时扫清所在列。

en_US.text:
[Manual rule] Double-click a sweeper → consume and sweep.
3 shared uses per run; costs 1 action with normal refill.

zh_CN.text:
[人工规则] 双击扫线手 → 消耗并扫线。
每局行列共用3次；花1次行动，正常补棋。

en_US.text: Sweep up to 3 rows centered on the source, truncated at edges. Applies to manual and removal triggers; grants no manual activation.

zh_CN.text: 行扫扩大至以所在行为中心的连续3行，边缘截断。主动发动与离场触发均生效，不授予主动权限。

en_US.text: Sweep up to 3 columns centered on the source, truncated at edges. Applies to manual and removal triggers; grants no manual activation.

zh_CN.text: 列扫扩大至以所在列为中心的连续3列，边缘截断。主动发动与离场触发均生效，不授予主动权限。

en_US.text:
[Manual rule] Row and column sweepers → cross clear.
Both span upgrades apply.

zh_CN.text:
[人工规则] 行、列扫线手 → 十字清除。
两轴跨度均生效。

en_US.text: Row, column and cross sweeps earn 2 extra points per directly removed piece (+2/level), counting overlaps once. Excludes the source and blast descendants; unaffected by the base-score multiplier.

zh_CN.text: 行、列与十字扫线每直接移除一枚棋子，本技能额外加2分（每级+2），交叉只计一次。不重复计来源与爆破后代；不受基础分倍率影响。

en_US.text: Row, column and cross sweeps earn 4 extra points per directly removed piece (+2/level), counting overlaps once. Excludes the source and blast descendants; unaffected by the base-score multiplier.

zh_CN.text: 行、列与十字扫线每直接移除一枚棋子，本技能额外加4分（每级+2），交叉只计一次。不重复计来源与爆破后代；不受基础分倍率影响。

en_US.text: Row, column and cross sweeps earn 6 extra points per directly removed piece (+2/level), counting overlaps once. Excludes the source and blast descendants; unaffected by the base-score multiplier.

en_US.text:
[Manual rule] Unlock core spawns and place a core now.
Only 1 on the board; explodes when removed.

zh_CN.text:
[人工规则] 解锁核心补给，立即放入核心。
场上限1枚；离场时爆炸。

en_US.text: [Manual rule] Arm up to 2 random ordinary pieces with fuses. Keep their colors.

zh_CN.text: [人工规则] 随机给至多2枚普通棋装引信，保留原色。

en_US.text: This skill adds 5 extra points per blast with actual removals (+5/level), including descendant blasts. Empty blasts give none; unaffected by the base-score multiplier.

zh_CN.text: 每次有实际移除的爆破，本技能额外加5分（每级+5），后代爆破也适用。空爆破不加分；不受基础分倍率影响。

en_US.text: This skill adds 10 extra points per blast with actual removals (+5/level), including descendant blasts. Empty blasts give none; unaffected by the base-score multiplier.

zh_CN.text: 每次有实际移除的爆破，本技能额外加10分（每级+5），后代爆破也适用。空爆破不加分；不受基础分倍率影响。

en_US.text: This skill adds 15 extra points per blast with actual removals (+5/level), including descendant blasts. Empty blasts give none; unaffected by the base-score multiplier.

en_US.text: Add 0.2 to the multiplier of base match points. Extra points are unaffected.

zh_CN.text: 匹配基础分的分数倍率＋0.2，额外得分不受影响。

en_US.text: This skill adds 10 extra points per nonempty match, sweep or scoring clear (+10/level). No bonus for an empty result; unaffected by the base-score multiplier.

zh_CN.text: 每个非空匹配、扫线或有分清理结果，本技能额外加10分（每级+10）。空结果不加分；不受基础分倍率影响。

en_US.text:
[Manual rule] Clear up to 3 random ordinary pieces, sparing fuses.
No points.

[人工规则] 随机清理至多3枚普通棋，保留引信。
不得分。

en_US.text:
[Manual rule] Clear 25% of ordinary pieces (round down).
No direct score; explosions score normally.

zh_CN.text:
[人工规则] 随机清理25%普通棋（向下取整）。
直接清理无分；引信爆炸照常计分。

en_US.text: For 3 actual refills, adjust the count by -1. Reacquiring extends uses, not amount. Skipped refills cost no uses; opposite modifiers cancel but both consume uses.
